hero.bio: Full-stack developer (Python, C#, React) based in Braga. Over 15 months at a home automation and energy startup, I grew from intern to Lead Full-Stack Developer. Looking for a role in software development.

about.title: About
about.p1: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Systems Engineering from IPCA. At A+CASA, a home automation and energy startup, I grew from intern to Lead Full-Stack Developer of the A+HOME residential product, installed in 10 to 20 homes.
about.p2: I worked on the front end and the back end in Python, JavaScript and React, with MQTT and REST API integrations and the system hosted on AWS, with Lambda functions and GitLab. At Web Summit 2025 I presented the company's business solution at its stand.
about.p3: I also build my own and freelance projects: the management system of Hotel Troia, in C# and React with TypeScript, and the hotel's website, in Next.js. I am looking for a software development role in Braga, Porto or remote.

items.description: I led the development of A+HOME, installed in 10 to 20 homes: architecture, technical decisions and delivery planning. I evolved the back office and the integrations in Python and React.
I replaced the Home Assistant interface with a custom front end backed by Python and built a back office to set up each client. We moved the system to AWS.
I built automations, energy monitoring and consumption dashboards in Home Assistant with Python and YAML. I integrated devices over MQTT and REST APIs and installed sensors on site.
Six-month internship at the Fujitsu Network Operations Centre. I worked on network infrastructure monitoring and systems administration. I also learnt to configure and maintain networks.
Two three-month academic internships in IT support: hardware maintenance, repair and troubleshooting.

nook.name: Nook
nook.lead: A home automation panel for Home Assistant, with a simulated Portuguese house behind it. The demo opens without a login: you come in as a visitor and control the house.

tablet.caption: The Home screen, on a wall tablet
tablet.alt: The Nook Home screen on a tablet, in Portuguese: the verdict that all is well, the temperature, lights, blinds and who is at home, the ground-floor plan with three lights on, plus six scene shortcuts.

phone.caption: The same screen, on a phone
phone.alt: The same screen on a phone, in a single column: the verdict, the four facts about the house, the floor plan and the tab bar at the bottom.

work: I designed and wrote the panel in JavaScript and CSS, with no dependencies and no build step. It adapts to the screen it is on.
I wrote the Python integration that simulates the house: lights, blinds, climate, cameras and 30 days of energy history.
I got it ready for the internet: a visitor can only control the simulated house, and administration only opens on the home network. It starts with one Docker Compose command.

hotelSystem.name: Hotel Management System (Freelance)
hotelSystem.lead: A management system for a 34-room hotel, replacing the paper booking chart and the 2013 door-lock software. It is used by the front desk, housekeeping and management.
work: I wrote the server in C#, which builds for .NET 8 and for .NET Framework 4.8, so it runs on the front desk's Windows 7 PC, with the data in SQLite.
I built the interface in React and TypeScript, in Portuguese and English: room map, bookings, check-in and check-out, payments and room key cards.
I added guest reports for the Portuguese border service (SIBA), GDPR tools, automatic backups and a Windows installer, with over 1,500 automated tests.

hotelSite.name: Hotel and Restaurant Website (Freelance)
hotelSite.lead: The hotel and restaurant website, with a digital menu and online bookings.
work: I built the website in Next.js.
I created the online booking system, with a PostgreSQL database.
I added a back office for the team to manage bookings.
